title: Jay Friedman (adtech/martech industry veteran) — applying Incorruptible's trust thesis to martech M&A: 'is there a Costco or USAA of martech/adtech?'
summary: Friedman is a long-time adtech and martech industry veteran. Reading Incorruptible while watching M&A and earnings move through his own market, he lands on how a brand or agency feels about working with a vendor as what decides which vendors keep the business, and asks why the sector has produced no company of the kind Ries holds up.
blockquote: Reading Incorruptible by Eric Ries and watching our martech/adtech market recently (M&A, earnings) and there's an overlap. Vendors do so much work to acquire/retain business, but I'm wondering - is how brands/agencies *feel* when working with a vendor - where vendors get it right or strike out? Is there a Costco or USAA of martech/adtech? Why aren't there more?
